title: 亚马逊雨林未来何去何从？巴西环保与农业的博弈
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: For the first time ever, the UN climate talks were held in the Amazon.
segments.zh: 联合国气候谈判首次在亚马逊举行。

segments.en: Dozens of indigenous protesters walked an entrance to the United Nations Climate Conference in Brazil Friday.
segments.zh: 周五，数十名原住民抗议者进入巴西联合国气候大会。

segments.en: The rainforest and its inhabitants were at the center of it all.
segments.zh: 雨林及其居民成为焦点。

segments.en: But so was the host nation's greatest contradiction.
segments.zh: 但主办国最大的矛盾也显现出来。

segments.en: Brazil over the last 40 years have turned for itself into the supermarket of the war.
segments.zh: 过去40年，巴西将自己变成了世界的超市。

segments.en: Brazil has built one of the most powerful agricultural economies on Earth.
segments.zh: 巴西建立了地球上最强大的农业经济之一。

segments.en: Soybean, beef, corn, all of it depends on clearly land.
segments.zh: 大豆、牛肉、玉米，都依赖土地。

segments.en: The amount of tropical rainforests lost last year is down by a third.
segments.zh: 去年热带雨林损失减少了三分之一。

segments.en: Yet, Brazil has also been celebrated as a conservation success story.
segments.zh: 然而，巴西也被誉为保护工作的成功典范。

segments.en: We forced lost dropping 41% in 2025 alone.
segments.zh: 仅在2025年，森林砍伐率就下降了41%。

segments.en: So can both things be true? The demand for this commodity hasn't gone anywhere.
segments.zh: 那么，这两件事能同时成立吗？对这种大宗商品的需求并未消失。

segments.en: And neither have the people who profit from them.
segments.zh: 从中获利的人也同样存在。
